terminals.name: backend-api
terminals.description: FastAPI backend en http://localhost:8000 (uv run uvicorn).
terminals.command: cd backend && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

terminals.name: frontend-dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; cd frontend && pnpm dev
